title: Memory Vault
description: Classic memory match — flip cards and find pairs. Fewer moves = better score.
how_to_play:
1. Press Enter to start.
2. Click two cards to flip them.
3. Match identical pairs to remove them from the board.
4. Complete the board in as few moves as possible.

Tips:
- Try to remember locations of symbols.
- Work methodically across the grid.
